title: Northwind Recalls Aurelia Kettle Due to Burn Hazard
hazard: The kettle's lid can detach during pouring, releasing scalding water onto the user.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the kettle and contact Northwind for a full refund.

title: Halcyon Recalls Trailhead Child Carrier Due to Fall Hazard
hazard: The carrier's hip belt buckle can release unexpectedly, allowing the child to fall.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the carrier and contact Halcyon for a free repair kit.

title: Vantage Foods Recalls Smoked Salmon Due to Listeria Risk
hazard: The product may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
remedy: Consumers should not eat the product and should return it to the place of purchase.
